standard_prerequisites.use: Together they let the proof assume that the target is a Noetherian affine scheme, since the higher direct images commute with etale localization and coherence can be tested etale locally.

standard_prerequisites.name: The three-condition criterion for coherence of the higher direct images over a Noetherian affine base
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter spaces-cohomology.tex, label lemma-property-higher-rank-cohomological-variant (invoked at proof lines 3863 and 3868)
standard_prerequisites.use: It reduces the affine case to three properties of the class of coherent modules: two-out-of-three for short exact sequences, stability under direct sums, and the reduction to a coherent module on a closed reduced irreducible subspace.

standard_prerequisites.name: The weak Chow lemma, producing a proper surjective cover mapping into projective space

standard_prerequisites.use: Applied to $Z \to \Spec(A)$ it yields the diagram with $\pi : Z' \to Z$ proper surjective and an immersion $i : Z' \to \mathbf{P}^n_A$, which becomes a closed immersion by properness.

standard_prerequisites.name: Vanishing of the higher direct images after twisting by a relatively ample invertible sheaf

standard_prerequisites.use: Applied to $\mathcal{L}$ with $\pi$ and with $g'$ it gives $d \gg 0$ for which all the higher direct images of $\mathcal{L}^{\otimes d}$ vanish, which is what makes $\mathcal{G} = \pi_*\mathcal{L}^{\otimes d}$ usable.

standard_prerequisites.name: Coherence of the pushforward of a globally generated sheaf on a closed subscheme of projective space

standard_prerequisites.use: It shows that $g_*\mathcal{G} = (g')_*\mathcal{L}^{\otimes d}$ is coherent, completing the verification of condition (3).

standard_prerequisites.name: Sandwiching of coherent modules in short exact sequences
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter spaces-cohomology.tex, labels lemma-coherent-abelian-Noetherian and lemma-coherent-Noetherian-quasi-coherent-sub-quotient (invoked at proof lines 3889 and 3890)
standard_prerequisites.use: They show that a module sandwiched between two coherent modules is coherent, which is how condition (1) is verified from the long exact sequence of higher direct images.

core_obligations: Note that $X$ is locally Noetherian so the statement makes sense, and reduce to the case of a Noetherian affine base using that higher direct images commute with etale localization and that coherence is etale local on the target (proof lines 3844-3853).

In the affine case observe that $f$ is of finite presentation, hence $X$ is Noetherian, and define the property $\mathcal{P}$ on coherent modules to which the three-condition criterion is applied (proof lines 3856-3869).

Verify conditions (1) and (2): two-out-of-three follows by sandwiching in the long exact sequence of higher direct images, and stability under direct sums from the splitting of $R^if_*$ on a direct sum together with the coherence of summands (proof lines 3872-3897).

Verify condition (3): reduce to a coherent module on a closed reduced irreducible $Z$, build the weak Chow diagram, twist by $\mathcal{L}$ to kill higher direct images for $d \gg 0$, and obtain coherence of $g_*\mathcal{G}$ from the projective space case (proof lines 3900-3968).

Check that the scheme theoretic support of $\mathcal{G}$ is all of $Z$, using a global section of $\mathcal{L}^{\otimes d}$ that does not vanish at a point over the generic point of $Z$ and the resulting nonvanishing of the induced map on stalks (proof lines 3970-4008).
proof_roadmap: Reduction to a Noetherian affine base (proof lines 3844-3853).
Setup of the property $\mathcal{P}$ on the coherent modules of the Noetherian space $X$ (proof lines 3856-3869).
Condition (3): the summand supported on $Z$, the weak Chow diagram, twisting, and coherence of the pushforward (proof lines 3900-3968).
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the higher direct images of a coherent module under a proper morphism of algebraic spaces to a locally Noetherian target are coherent (statement lines 3834-3841). The proof first reduces to a Noetherian affine base by etale locality, then invokes a three-condition criterion for the class of coherent modules, verifying two-out-of-three and direct-sum stability, and finally reduces condition (3) to a sheaf on a closed reduced irreducible subspace that is dominated by a proper cover mapping into projective space, where twisting and a support computation finish the argument. The reduction to the criterion and the support verification are the substance, so the claim is H2.
